tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha mang po'i mtshan tho rin chen bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na ma gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ sgrib bral lhan skyes bde chen ye shes dang*/ rlung sems tsam gyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i sku/ /dbyer med zung 'jug rigs rnams kun gyi rje/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen zhabs la 'dud/ /mgon des gdul bya'i don du rgyud sde'i rim/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa gsum gsungs kun gyi/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi rab dbye brjod dka' yang*/ che long tsam zhig dad pas brjod par bya/ /de yang sbyir dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dbye ba dang mtshan tsam zhig ji ltar yin pa shes shing bzung na yang phan yon che bar bshad pas/ 'dir dkyil 'khor grags che chung ci rigs phal che ba'i grangs dang*/ lha rnams kyi mtshan gyi dbye ba cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi dang pha rgyud ma rgyud rim pas phye na mang yang de ltar so sor gsal bar ma phye bar gsang 'jigs gnyis nas bzung ste brjod na/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha so gnyis te/ gtso bo mi bskyod pa yab yum/ 'khor rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med don grub ste gshegs pa bzhi dang*/ spyan ma mā ma ki gos dkar mo sgrol ma ste yum bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma sgra rdo rje ma dri rdo rje ma ro rdo rje ma ste rdo rje ma bzhi dang*/ byams pa sa snying phyag rdor nam snying 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dpal sgrib sel kun bzang ste sems dpa' brgyad dang*/ gshin rje gshed shes rab mthar byed rta mgrin bgegs mthar byed mi g.yo ba 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon can stobs po che gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur gnod mdzes rgyal po te khro bo bcu'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dang zhe sdang rdo rje gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor song ba yod kyang de gnyis mi bskyod par 'dus pas mi 'gal lo/ /de ni mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor te gzhan lha so gnyis po re re nas gtso bor song ba'i dkyil 'khor so gnyis yod pa rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa las bshad cing*/

jo bo rjes gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsang 'dus 'jam rdor lha bcu dgu ma bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i lha bcu dgu ni/ 'jam rdor yab yum/ gshegs pa bzhi/ yum bzhi/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma gnyis dang*/ sgo bzhi'i khro bo bzhi rnams so/ /rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i tshig zin las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gcig tu byas nas gshegs pa bzhi/ yum bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi ste lha bcu gsum bshad de 'di bzhin bzhed pa'ang yod kyang*/ lha so gnyis ni yongs su rdzogs pa'o// //༈ gshin rje gshed la dpa' gcig dang de'i lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ dgra nag bcu gsum ma dang*/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma gnyis dang zhe dgu ma rnams su yod cing*/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig ni 'khor med pa'i 'jigs byed yab rkyang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs so/ /'jigs byed bcu gsum ma ni gtso bo 'jigs byed yab yum/ gti mug ser sna 'dod chags phrag dog gshin rje gshed bzhi dang*/ tho ba dbyug pa pad+ma ral gri gshin rje gshed bzhi dang*/ tsa rtsi ka phag mo dang dbyangs can ma go ri ste yum bzhi rnams so/ /'di dag gi yab yum rnams so sor phye nas nyer drug go /dgra nag bcu gsum ma dang*/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i gtso bo gnyis ma gtogs 'khor rnams ni 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang 'dra'o/ /yang 'jigs byed ma ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig kyang bshad do/ /༈ zhe dgu ma la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i zhe dgu ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gtso bo 'jam dbyangs/ 'khor phyogs bzhir gti mug ser sna 'dod chags phrag dog rdo rje ste bzhi dang*/ mtshams su sems ma rdo rje ma rin chen rdo rje ma chos rdo rje ma las kyi rdo rje ma bzhi dang*/ shar du rdo rje rnon po ral gri byams pa 'jam dpal ye shes sku ngag gi dbang phyug zla 'od ye shes mtsho ste brgyad dang*/

lhor rdo rje sna tshogs gnod sbyin khu tshur chos srung ba rnon po rgyu dra ba can gyi 'od de brgyad dang*/ nub tu rdo rje smra ba rdor sems rgyal po chags pa legs pa rin chen nyi ma'i 'od nyi ma ste brgyad dang*/ byang du rdo rje dbal bzhed pa spos kyi glang po ye shes tog thabs kyis 'gro ba rgya mtsho'i blo gros blo gros mi zad pa bdud rtsi'i 'od de brgyad dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ste bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir rdo rje gnod mdzes gtsug tor hūṃ mdzad gzhan gyis mi thub pa bzhi rnams so/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i lha zhe dgu ni/ khro bo'i rdo rje dang mgo dang lag pa sogs zhe dgu /yongs su gyur pa ma dbus su 'jigs byed dang*/ nang gi phyogs bzhi la sogs pa rgyu'i lha rnams kyi gnas su rdo rje mgo dang lag pa la sogs pa'i ming can gyi 'bras bu'i lha rnams te/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag ma he'i gdong pa can no// //༈ bde mchog gi skor la yab skor dang yum skor gnyis kyi dang po la lha re gnyis ma dang*/ bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha lnga ma sogs mang yang dang po ni/ dbus su gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang*/ phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma lā ma dung skyes ma gzugs can ma bzhi dang*/ thugs kyi 'khor lor khaṇ+ḍa kā pa la dang rab gtum ma/ ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum mig ma/ kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ pu ra bai ri ṇa dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ 'od dpag med dang lawa ri/ rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste brgyad zung dang*/ gsung gi 'khor lor myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ rdo rje ral ba dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ dpa' bo chen mo dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/

'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste brgyad zung dang*/ sku'i 'khor lor stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i zhugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dung skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste brgyad zung dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lor sgo bzhi dang mtshams bzhir kha gdong ma 'ug gdong ma khyi gdong ma phag gdong ma ste bzhi dang*/ gshin rje brtan ma dang pho nya mo dang mche ba ma dang gshin rje 'joms ma bzhi ste brgyad dang bcas pa khyod bsdoms re gnyis so/ /'dir lū dril gnyis lha'i grangs 'dra yang phyag dang phyag mtshan sogs la mi 'dra ba yod do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' bo rnams so sor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum yod par bshad cing*/ lha bcu gsum ma ni gtso bo yab yum la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /lha lnga ma ni gtso bo yab yum la rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba dang*/ lhan skyes ni 'khor med pa'i gtso bo yab yum ste zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso che'o/ /༈ gzhan yang bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la phag mo dmar mos 'khyud cing*/ snga ma lta bu'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang*/ snga ma lta bu'i sgo mtshams brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ bde mchog sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la phag mo dmar mos 'khyud cing*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi sku mdog ser po dang*/ thugs 'khor gyi dpa' bo rnams sku mdog nag po dang dpa' mo rnams dkar po/ gsung 'khor gyi dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dmar po dang dpa' mo rnams kyang dmar po/ sku 'khor gyi dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po dang dpa' bo rnams dmar po/

sgo mtshams ma rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'o/ /gnyis pa yul skor la rdo rje phag mo lha so bdun ma ni/ dbus su rdo rje phag mo dmar mo la rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba dang*/ 'khor lo gsum la yab rnams bzhag ste rab gtum ma la sogs pa yum nyer bzhi ste de rnams sku mdog dkar po dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lor sgo mtshams brgyad spyi ltar ro/ /yang rdo rje phag mo lha so bdun ma ni/ dbus su rdo rje phag mo sngon mo la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang bde mchog sngon po phyag gnyis pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rtsibs rnams la phag mo dmar mo'i skabs ltar dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lor bde mchog phyag gnyis pa'i skabs ltar ro/ /rdo rje phag mo ser mo lha so bdun ni/ dbus su phag mo ser mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi phyag gnyis ma dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' mo rnams sku mdog dmar nag dkar ba'o/ /sgo mtshams ma rnams sku mdog spyi ltar dang phyag gnyis ma'o/ /'on kyang g.yon mi mgo 'dzin pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /der ma zad phag mo lha lnga ma dang bcu gsum ma yang yod do// //༈ bde mchog rdor sems lha so bdun ni/ dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang sogs gshegs pa bzhi zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ mtshams bzhir spyan sogs lha mo bzhi ste mā ma ki zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang gzhan gsum phyag brgyad ma dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i phyogs mtshams su rdo rje drag mo gzugs rdo rje ma 'dod chags rdo rje ma rdo rje zhi ba ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sgra rdo rje ma sa rdo rje ma rnams dang*/ rim pa gsum par bzhad ma sgeg mo glu ma gar ma rnams dang*/ gling bu ma pi wang ma mu kuṇ+ḍa ma rdza rnga ma rnams dang*/ phyi'i snam bur me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma rnams dang*/

me long ma ro ma reg bya ma chos ma rnams dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi'o/ /bde mchog 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug ni/ phyi dkyil gyi nang gi dbus su rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ mthar rnam snang rin 'byung snang mtha' mi bskyod pa don grub gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i gtso bo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang sbyor ba/ mthar mkha' 'gro ma lā ma dung skyes ma gzugs can ma rnams dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma la sogs pa thugs kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po yum bcas dang*/ mthar chang dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma la sogs thugs kyi dpa' mo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ rin 'byung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo yum bcas dang*/ mthar myu gu can dang sa glung ma la sogs gsung gi dpa' bo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo yum bcas dang*/ mthar shin tu bzang mo dang sngo bsangs lha mo sogs gsung gi dpa' bo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i nag po yum bcas dang*/ mthar stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma sogs sku'i dpa' bo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ don grub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang khu yum bcas dang*/ mthar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo sogs sku'i dpa' bo dpa' mo zung bzhi dang*/ phyi dkyil gyi sgo dang mtshams su kha gdong ma sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa'o/ /kyai rdor gyi skor la/ kyai rdor lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhi las snying po'i kyai rdor ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kyai rdor sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum bdag med ma dang sbyor ba/

'dab ma brgyad la phyogs mtshams su gau ri ser mo/ chom rkun ma dmar mo/ ro langs ma dkar ser/ /sma ni ljang ser/ pu ka si ser mo/ sha wa ri dkar mo/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mo/ ḍoṃ bhi ni nag mo rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu mtshams bzhir gling bum pi wang ma mu kuṇ+ḍa rdza rnga ma rnams dang*/ sgo bzhir rta gdong ma phag gdong ma khyi gdong ma seng gdong ma rnams te bcu bdun no/ yang thugs kyai rdo rje'i lha bcu bdun ma ni/ dbus su kyai rdor nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dang sbyor ba/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje drag mo gzugs rdo rje ma 'dod chags rdo rje ma rdo rje zhi ba ma dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin rdo rje mkha' 'gro sgra rdo rje ma sa rdo rje ma rnams dang*/ phyi rol tu gling bu ma pi wang ma mu kuṇ+ḍa rdza rnga ma rnams dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma rnams so/ /yang gsung kyai rdo rje'i lha bcu bdun ma ni/ dbus su kyai rdo nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa yum phag mo dang bcas shing*/ 'khor rnams thugs kyai rdo rje dang 'dra'o/ /yang*/ sku kyai rdo rje'i lha bcu bdun ma ni/ dbus su kyai rdor nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bdag med ma la 'khyud cing*/ 'khor rnams ni thugs kyai rdo rje dang 'dra'o/ /kyai rdor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bzhi las dang po ni/ dbus su kyai rdor sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa yum bdag med ma dang sbyor ba/ phyogs mtshams su sngar ltar gau ri tsau ri be ta li ghasma ri rnams dang*/ pu ka si ri khrod ma gdol ba mo g.yung mo rnams so/ /yang*/ thugs kyai rdor lha dgu ni/ dbus su kyai rdor sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang sbyor ba/ 'khor rnams sngar ltar ro/ /yang*/ gsung kyai rdor lha dgu ni/ dbus su kyai rdo rje ldan la zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bdag med ma dang sbyor ba/

'khor rnams kyang sngar ltar ro/ /sku kyai rdor lha dgu ni/ dbus su kyai rdor sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bcas phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa ste gzhan thugs kyai rdo rje lha dgu dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /kyai rdor yum skor la gnyis las bdag med ma lha mo nyer gsum la ni/ dbus su rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ 'khor du rdo rje ma gau ri ma chu ma mkha' 'gro ma bzhi sa dang*/ gau ri tsau ri be ta li ghasma ri bzhi dang*/ pu ka si sogs bzhi dang*/ mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma gnyis dang*/ gling bu ma sogs bzhi dang*/ rta gdong ma sogs bzhi ste gong gi kyai rdor gyi skabs ltar ro/ /yang*/ bdag med ma lha mo bcwo lnga ni/ dbus su bdag med ma/ 'khor du rdo rje ma sogs bzhi dang*/ gau ri sogs brgyad dang mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma gnyis rnams so// //༈ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i lha zhe gsum pa ni/ dbus su rnam snang 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang sbyor ba/ nang gi phyogs bzhir mi bskyod pa la sogs pa yab bzhi zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas/ mtshams bzhir spyan sogs bzhi dang*/ yang sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin chen rdo rje ma/ chos rdo rje ma/ las kyi rdo rje ma rnams dang*/ tsun+da phyag nyer drug ma/ rin chen skar mda'/ khro gnyer can/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma rnams dang*/ phyi rol gyi snam bu la phyogs rer bzhi bzhi ste byams pa 'jam dpal spos kyi glang po ye shes tog bzang skyong blo gros rgya mtsho blo gros mi zad pa spobs pa brtsegs pa rnams dang*/ mthu chen thob mya ngan dang mun pa sel ba dra ba can gyi 'od zla ba'i 'od 'od dpag med nam mkha' mdzod sgrib sel spos kyi glang bo ste de rnams ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /sgo dang mtshams su gsang 'dus ltar gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu rnams so/

/༈ mkha' 'gro rigs bsdus ni/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dkyil 'khor lnga yod pa'i dbus ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor/ shar ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro /lho ma rin chen mkha' 'gro /nub ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang ma sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor te/ dbus ma'i gtso mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa de'i phyogs mtshams su gau ri tsau ri be ta li*/ sma ri bzhi dang*/ pu ka si sha wa ri tsaṇ+ḍa li ḍoṃ bhi ni bzhi rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /shar ma'i dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sngon po zhal gsum phyag bcu drug ma/ de'i phyogs mtshams su kaṃ pa ma zhags pa rnga zlum ma lcags kyu ma rnams dang*/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma rnams so/ /lho ma'i dbus su rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser mo zhal phyag gi grangs snga ma lta bu/ de'i phyogs mtshams su nyi phyag ma mar me ma skar mda' ma glog phyag ma rnams dang*/ sgeg mo ma phreng ba ma glu ma gar ma rnams so/ /nub ma'i dbus su pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo zhal phyag sngar ltar dang*/ de'i phyogs mtshams su pad+ma ma chos 'byung ma lcags sgrog ma rang 'khyud ma rnams dang*/ gling bu ma pi wang ma rnga zlum ma rdza rnga ma rnams so/ /byang ma'i dbus su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro rta gdong can ljang gu zhal phyag sngar ltar dang*/ de'i phyogs mtshams su sgo lcags ma lde kyog ma sgo glegs ma yol ba ma rnams dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi rnams so/ /phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi sgo mtshams su gau ri tsau ri sogs gong du bshad pa ltar brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba'o// //༈ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad khro bo bcus bskor ba ni/ dbus su 'jig rten gsum rgyal sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas dang*/ mthar khro bo dbyug sngon can nyi ma gtsug tor 'khyil pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dus nag po chen po 'jigs rung nag po bzhi dang*/

steng du gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur dang 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og ste thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'o// //༈ lha mo ku ru ku la lha bcwo lnga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru ku la dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ mthar rdo rje ma gau ri chu ma mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang*/ gau ri tsau ri nas sngar ltar mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma ste bcu'o/ /sgrol ma lha bcu gcig ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sgrol ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ mthar me tog sgrol ma de bzhin du bdug spos mar me dri chab sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma bzhi/ steng 'og tu gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang gnod mdzes ma rnams dang bcas pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi lha nyer gcig ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje bdud rtsi ljang ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas/ mthar zhi ba ma zhi gdong ma zla ldan ma ri bo can bzhi dang*/ zla dkyil ma zla tshes ma yid 'ong ma yid tshim ma bzhi dang*/ rim pa gnyis par me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma bzhi dang*/ snam bu la gling bu pi wang mu kuṇ+ḍa rdza rnga ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir khro gnyer rim ldan dang 'jigs sdigs rta'i gzugs can tshogs kyi gtso bo ste bzhi rnams so/ /thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad lha nyer dgu ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje hūṃ mdzad nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas/ mthar rdo rje snying po ma mtshon cha ma reg bya rdo rje ma ki li ki la ma bzhi dang*/ lha sna ma nang mar pi wang ma gling bu ma glu ma rdza rnga ma bzhi dang*/ sgeg mo phreng ba ma glu ma gar ma bzhi dang*/ phyi mar byams pa 'jam dpal nam snying phyag na rin chen kun bzang 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib sel sa snying ste brgyad dang*/ mtshams su me tog ma bdug spos ma mar me ma dri chab ma bzhi dang*/

sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhi rnams so/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung lha nyer gcig ni/ dbus su rdo rje khrag 'thung sngon po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ mthar gtsigs chen ma rnam par gtsigs ma gtum mo g.yung mo bzhi dang*/ ser skya ma ku li ni drag mo 'jigs byed ma bzhi dang*/ lha snam la me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma bzhi dang*/ pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir ba glang sna glang chen sna zhal mdzes ma zhal sdug ma bzhi rnams so// //༈ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lha bcu gsum ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje bdud rtsi ma bdud rtsi'i zhal ma bdud rtsi'i lus can ma bdud rtsi'i spyan ma bzhi dang*/ a me ma gzugs bzang ma mdzes ma bde sgrub ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi rnams te thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bcas/ de'i phyogs bzhir phreng ba can thod pa can 'jigs pa can mi thub ma bzhi dang*/ rim pa gnyis par dge ba'i ske rag ma gzugs can ma rnam rgyal ma 'dod ma bzhi dang*/ 'dod can ma dus can ma mtsho chen ma byed ma gsod ma bzhi dang*/ gsum par sgrol ma 'jigs mthong ma legs mthong ma thub dka' ma bzhi dang*/ dge ma grib gnon ma dus mtshan ma rlung grags chen mo bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir mdzes ma nor 'dzin ma skal bzang ma yid 'ong ma bzhi ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o// //༈ yang thod pa lha dgu ni dbus su sangs rgyas thod pa/ mthar 'dab ma brgyad la sna tshogs bde ma 'dod ma sa 'og na gnas ma legs bzang ma bzhi dang*/ chang 'tshong ma 'byung mo phyag bzhi ma nam mkhar gnas ma bzhi rnams so// //༈ sgyu ma chen mo lha lnga ni/

dbus su bcom ldan 'das sgyu ma chen mo sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa yum bcas/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// //༈ rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' lha nga brgyad ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma ro langs ma gtum mo bzhi dang*/ sed+ge ma stag mo lce spyang ma 'ug pa ma bzhi dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma mar me ma 'jigs byed ma kam po tsi bzhi dang*/ lha snam la pu ka si tra mi ṭī gtum mo 'jigs byed ma khrag ma sham drag shul ma 'bar ma mi sdug ma rnams dang*/ thod pa ma rdo rje ma bum pa can ma sgeg mo dri chab ma pi wang ma me tog ma glu ma bdug spos ma gar ma mar me ma rnams dang*/ sgo mtshams rnams su khyab 'jug tshangs pa dbang phyug gdong drug dbang po lus ngan gshin rje chu lha rnams dang*/ phyi'i lha snam la keng rus 'jigs byed kha ṭ+waṃ ka'i srin po tshogs kyi dbang phyug dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dang*/ gtum mo'i dbang phyug lha 'dun sa'i lha rim gyis dbang phyug dzāṃ ka ra 'jigs su rung ba rnams dang*/ drag po'i 'dod pa shaṇ+ḍi la'i dbang phyug ḍa ma ru'i 'dul byed rnga sgra'i 'jigs byed rnams dang gtum bu ra'i dbang phyug swā ra na do mche ba gtsigs pa gzhu 'dzin rnams te yum dang bcas pa'o/ /༈ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro lha bcu gsum pa ni/ dbus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma ro langs ma gtum mo bzhi dang*/ mtshams su sed+ge mo sed+ge'i gdong ba can stag ma stag gdong can lce spyang ma spyang gdong can 'ug pa ma 'ug gdong can bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rgyal ba'i dbang phyug ma gsal byed ma 'jigs byed ma kam po dzi ste bzhi'o/

/༈ gzhan yang phyag rdor 'khor chen sogs bla med kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu mang ngo*// //༈ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lha drug brgya so bzhi ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang*/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog nag po zhal gsum phyag nyer bzhi pa sna tshogs yum dang sbyor ba/ mthar phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams su nag po 'bar ma dmar mo 'bar ma ser mo 'bar ma dkar po 'bar ma bzhi dang*/ du ba ma smig sgyu ma mar me ma mkha' snang ma bzhi dang*/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyogs mtshams su don grub rin 'byung rnam snang 'od dpag med bzhi dang*/ yang sgrol ma sogs yum bzhi la yab bzhis 'khyud pa dang*/ lha snam la kun bzang nam snying phyag rdor sa snying chos dbyings rdo rje ma sgrib sel skra rdo rje ma 'jig rten dbang phyug brgyad la rim pa bzhin du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dri rdo rje ma sgra rdo rje ma gzugs rdo rje ma kun bzang reg bya rdo rje ma phyag rdor ro rdo rje ma rnams kyis 'khyud pa ste lha pho gnyis kyis tshur skyor ba'o/ /yang reg bya rdo rje ma ro rdo rje ma dri rdo rje ma gzugs rdo rje ma bzhi la sgrib sel 'jig rten dbang phyug nam snying sa snying bzhis 'khyud pa dang*/ sgo bzhir khro bo shin tu stobs rmongs byed rengs byed nga rgyal byed bzhi la yum rengs byed ma nga rgyal byed ma shin tu stobs ma rmongs byed ma bzhis 'khyud pa dang*/ gsung dkyil gyi 'dod snam la dri chab ma phreng ba ma bdug spos ma mar me ma bzhi dang*/ sgeg mo bzhad ma bdud rtsi ma mi zad ma bzhi dang*/ gar ma 'dod pa ma sgra ma glu ma bzhi ste bcu gnyis dang*/ yang tsa rtsi ka nag mo yab bcas la 'jigs byed ma dang drag mo dus kyi mche ba ma me 'bar gdong ma rlung shugs ma rab gtum ma drag mig ma sna chen ma brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/

yang khyab 'jug ma nag po yab bcas la dpal mo dang sgyu ma mo grags ma phun tshogs ma rnam rgyal ma dpal ldan rgyal ma rgyal byed ma dpal ldan 'khor lo can rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang phag mo dmar mo yab bcas keng rus ma dus mtshan ma rab khros gdong ma dus kyi lce ma gtsigs ma nag mo 'jigs rung ma gzugs ngan ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang gzhon nu ma dmar mo yab bcas la lus med ma gzhon nu ma ri dwags bdag ma rin chen phreng ba ma mig bzang ma sdug ma bzang mo rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang dbang mo ser mo yab bcas la rdo rje 'od ma rdo rje lus can gser ldan ma las dbang ma ri mo sna tshogs mchu shing ma zug rngu ma shin tu mig 'bras ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang tshangs ma ser mo yab bcas la sā bir+t+ri pad+ma'i spyan chu skyes can blo gros ma ngag dbang ma glu ma glog ma dran ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang drag mo dkar mo yab bcas la/ go ri ma kaṃ ka ma rtag ma myur ma to ta lā mtshon byed ma dmar ser ma nag mo rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang bdun tshogs ma dkar mo yab bcas la dpal ldan ma zla ba'i ri mo ma ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdong ma dang sa'i gdong can ma nyams dga' ma pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma spyan myur ma dri med ri bong 'dzin ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang/ yang sku dkyil gyi snam bu sogs pad+ma'i lte bar bden bral bdag po yum bcas la nag pa zla ba'i tshes la lhu ba'i lha mo nya rdo rje ma nyī rdo rje ma nyir )rdo rje nyu rdo rje ma bzhi dang*/ nyil )rdo rje ma nyaṃ rdo rje ma dzha rdo rje ma dzhi rdo rje ma dzhir )rdo rje ma dzhu rdo rje ma dzh-il )rdo rje ma dzhi rdo rje ma brgyad dang*/ dza rdo rje ma dzi rdo rje ma dzu rdo rje ma dzil )rdo rje ma dzi rdo rje ma tsha rdo rje ma tshi rdo rje ma tsh-ir )rdo rje ma tshu rdo rje ma tsh-il)rdo rje ma tshaṃ rdo rje ma tsa rdo rje ma tsi rdo rje ma ts-ir )rdo rje ma tsu rdo rje ma ts-il )rdo rje ma bcu drug ste nyer brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/

yang rlung lha nag po yum bcas la sa ga zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo tsa rdo rje ma tsi rdo rje ma ts-ir) rdo rje ma tsū rdo rje ma bzhi la sogs pa rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang gshin rje dmar po yum bcas la dbo zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo kū rdo rje ma kā rdo rje ma kṛ rdo rje ma kū rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang me lha dmar po yum bcas la snron zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo ṇa ṇi ṇṛ ṇu rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang gdong drug dmar po yum bcas la chu stod zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo ṭā ṭī ṭ-i? ṭū rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang lus ngan ser po yum bcas la rgyal zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo sā rdo rje ma sī rdo rje ma sṛ rdo rje ma sū rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang dbang po ser po yum bcas la tha skar zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo na ni nṛ nu rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang tshangs pa ser po yum bcas la smin drug zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo tā tī tṛ tu rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang drag po dkar po yum bcas la mgo zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo thakathika thṛ thaku )rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang chu lha dkar po yum bcas la gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo ma mi mṛ mū rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang tshogs bdag dkar po yum bcas la khrums stod zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo pā pī pṛ pū rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang khyab 'jug nag po yum bcas la mchu zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo nga ngi ngaṛ )nga rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams

so/ /yang dbyug sngon can la 'od zer can dang 'dod rgyal la tsun+da dang stobs po che la rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang mi g.yo ba la khro gnyer can dang*/ gtsug gtor 'khor bsgyur la shin tu sngon mo dang gnod mdzes rgyal po la drag mig mas 'khyud pa dang*/ yang klu pad+ma dang stobs rgyu la khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong la phag gdong ma dang rgod gdong ma/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po la lce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong ma/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan la stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba la sngon mo dang rdo rje mig can mas 'khyud pa dang*/ yang khyi gdong ma bya rog gdong ma dang rgod gdong ma/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po la lce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong ma/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan la stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba la sngon mo dang rdo rje mig can mas 'khyud pa dang*/ yang khyi gdong ma bya rog gdong ma phag gdong ma rgod gdong ma stag gdong ma 'ug gdong ma lce spyang gdong ma mkha' lding gdong ma sngon mo dang rdo rje mig can ma gnyis te bcu dang*/ yang nyi ma dang zla ba mig dmar lhag pa mjug ring spen pa pa sangs phur bu sgra gcan dus me brtan pa ri ṣi dang*/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad khyim bcu gnyis cha bcu drug phyogs skyong bcu dga' byed dbang phyug dang bhṛng gi ri ti ngang nag po chen po dril bu'i sna can zhing skyong rnams dang 'phrog ma dang grub pa thabs cad dang*/ yang dbye 'dod ma dang gos 'dod ma 'khrug 'dod ma mchol 'dor ma spro 'dod ma gdung 'dod ma reg bya 'dod ma yan lag bskyod ma lhag ma za 'dod ma dang*/ bskyod 'dod ma za 'dod ma dri 'dod ma gar 'dod ma skem 'dod ma 'gug 'dod ma rgyugs 'dod ma zag 'dod ma g.yul 'dod ma dang*/ rengs 'dod ma dri chab 'dod ma brnyos 'dod ma rgyal 'dod ma bcings 'dod ma 'khrig 'dod ma phur bu 'debs 'dod ma 'ching 'dod ma dang*/

rgyas 'dod ma rgyan 'dod ma stan 'dod ma srid 'dod ma smra 'dod ma rol mo 'dod ma 'chang 'dod ma rtsod 'dod ma sdig 'dod ma ste so drug bcas bsdus nas bshad pa'o// //༈ rnal 'byor rgyud de nyid bsdus pa nas bshad pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor pī ltang gsum ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rnam snang dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa phyogs bzhir sems ma rdo rje ma rin chen rdo rje ma chos kyi rdo rje ma las kyi rdo rje ma bzhi dang*/ shar du pad+ma'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ 'dab ma bzhir rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje chags pa rdo rje lags pa bzhi dang*/ lho'i pad+ma'i lte bar rin 'byung*/ 'dab ma bzhir rdo rje rin chen rdo rje gzi brjid rdo rje rgyal mtshan rdo rje bzhad pa bzhi dang*/ nub kyi pad+ma'i lte bar snang ba mtha' yas/ 'dab ma la rdo rje chos rdo rje rnon po rdo rje rgyu rdo rje smra ba bzhi dang*/ byang gi pad+ma'i lte bar don grub/ 'dab ma la rdo rje las rdo rje srung ba rdo rje gnod sbyin rdo rje khu tshur bzhi dang*/ grwa bzhir sgeg mo ma phreng ba ma glu ma gar ma bzhi dang*/ lha snam la byams pa mthong ba don yod mya ngan dang mun pa nges 'joms kyi blo dang*/ spos kyi glang po dpa' 'gro nam mkha' mdzod ye shes tog dang*/ 'od dpag med zla 'od bzang skyong dra ba can gyi 'od/ rdo rje snying po blo gros mi zad pa spobs pa brtsegs pa kun bzang rnams dang*/ mtshams su bdug pa ma me tog ma mar me ma dri chab ma dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu sogs bzhi'o// //༈ kun rig rtsa ba'i lha so bdun dang mgron thabs kyi lha ni/ dbus su rnam snang zhal bzhi phyag gnyis pa/ phyogs bzhir ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po rgyal mchog rin chen shākya rigs dbang me tog cher rgyas bzhi/ mtshams su spyan ma mā ma ki gos dkar mo sgrol ma bzhi dang*/

phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs rnams la gong du smos pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' nas rdo rje khu tshur gyi bar bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug dang*/ nang gi mtshams bzhir sgeg ma sogs bzhi dang*/ phyi'i mtshams bzhir bdug pa ma sogs bzhi dang*/ nang gi sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu sogs bzhi dang*/ lha snam nang ma'i phyogs bzhir byams pa nas kun bzang gi bar bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug dang*/ bar pa'i phyogs bzhir dga' bo nas 'od srung gi bar bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug dang*/ phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams su gdung sel nas yid myur pa'i bar bcu gnyis dang*/ phyi'i sgo bzhir 'jig rten gsum snang nas dril bu ma'i bar khro bo bcu gnyis dang khro mo bzhi ste bcu drug rnams dang*/ phyi'i khor yug tu rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon don lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams te bsdus nas bshad pa'o/ /༈ gtsug dgu'i lha so bdun ni/ dbus su shākya sed+ge sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje gtsug tor rin chen gtsug tor pad+ma'i gtsug tor sna tshogs gtsug tor bzhi dang*/ gtsug tor gzi brjid gtsug tor rgyal mtshan gtsug tor rnon po gtsug tor gdugs dkar bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu sgeg mo ma phreng ba ma glu ma gar ma bzhi dang*/ lha snam la byams pa mthong ba don yod nas kun tu bzang po'i bar kun rig gi mgron thabs kyi sems dpa' bcu drug ltar dang*/ de'i phyogs mtshams su me tog ma bdug pa mar me dri chab ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhi rnams so// //༈ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dang slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i lugs kyi chos dbyings gsung dbang lha nyis brgya nyer gcig ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ser po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ de'i mthar phyogs mtshams su gtsug tor chen po gtsug tor gdugs dkar gtsug tor gzi brjid phung po rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor bzhi dang*/

gtsug tor 'od zer rnam 'phro gtsug tor 'phags pa gtsug tor cher 'phags pa gtsug tor rgyal ba bzhi dang*/ shar gyi re mig gi dbus su mi bskyod pa zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i mthar rdo rje sems dpa' sogs bzhis bskor ba dang*/ lho'i dbus su rin 'byung ser po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i mthar rdo rje rin chen sogs sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nub kyi dbus su snang mtha' dmar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i mthar rdo rje chos sogs sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ byang gi dbus su don grub ljang khu zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i mthar rdo rje las sogs sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba dang*/ dbang ldan du spyan ma mer mā ma ki bden bral du gos dkar mo rlung du sgrol ma ste bzhi dang sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu sogs bzhi'o// //༈ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i shar du mos spyod kyi sa ma rab dga'i sa ma dri med ma 'od byed ma 'od 'phro ma sbyangs dka' ma mngon gyur ma ring du song ma mig g.yo ma legs pa'i blo gros ma chos kyi sprin ma kun tu 'od ma ste bcu gnyis dang*/ lhor rin chen pad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin ma sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma/ de bzhin du tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab thabs smon lam stobs ye shes las kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ste bcu gnyis dang nub tu tshe la dbang ba de bzhin du sems dang yo byad las skye ba rdzu 'phrul mos pa smon lam ye shes chos la dbang ba ste bcu'i steng du de bzhin nyid ma dang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ma gnyis te bcu gnyis dang*/ byang du dbyig gi blo gros ma rin chen skar mda' gtsug tor rnam rgyal 'od zer can ma ri khrod lo ma can dug sel ma dang*/ sgo mtha' yas ma tsun+da shes rab 'phel ma las sgrib rnam sel ma ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod ma ste bcu gnyis dang*/ sgo bzhir chos so sor yang dag rig ma de bzhin du don dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa so sor yang dag rig ma bzhi dang*/

mtshams su sgeg mo ma phreng ba ma glu ma gar ma bzhi dang bcas lha mo nga drug dang*/ snam bu la shar du kun bzang blo gros mi zad pa sa snying nam snying bzhi dang*/ lhor nam mkha' mdzod phyag na rin chen blo gros rgya mtsho rdo rje'i snying po bzhi dang*/ nub tu spyan ras gzigs mthu chen thob zla 'od dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi dang*/ byang du 'od dpag med spobs pa brtsegs pa mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges 'joms blo gros sgrib pa rnam sel bzhi ste bcu drug dang*/ shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed lhor shes rab mthar byed nub tu pad+ma mthar byed byang du bgegs mthar byed bzhi dang*/ mtshams su 'jig rten gsum rgyal rdo rje nyi ma he ru ka rta mchog ste brgyad dang*/ steng 'og tu 'khor bsgyur dang gnod mdzes gnyis te bcu'o/ / dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i grwa bzhir me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma bzhi dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje ma bzhi ste brgyad dang*/ dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i phyogs mtshams su brgya byin gshin rje chu lha lus ngan bzhi dang*/ dbang phyug me lha srin pa glung lha ste brgyad dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug gdong drug bzhi rang gi yum dang bcas pa dang*/ tshangs ma khyab 'jug ma drag mo gzhon nu ma dbang mo rnams ni rang gi yab la 'khyud pa dang*/ phag mo tsa muṇ+ḍi 'bring gi ri ti tshogs bdag nag po chen po dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ nyi ma zla ba mig dmar lhag pa phur bu pa sangs spen pa sgra gcan mjug ring dang*/ stobs bzang rgyal bar byed pa sbrang rtsir byed pa dpyid kyi lha dang*/ mtha' yas nor rgyas sogs klu chen brgyad dang*/ thag bzang ris stobs ldan tshim byed rnam par snang byed de lha ma yin gyi rgyal po bzhi dang*/ nam mkha' ld-ing gi rgyal po mi'am ci'i rgyal po dri za'i rgyal po rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po bzhi dang*/

gang ba bzang po nor bu bzang po nor sbyin rnam thos sras pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ki mā li sgo'i dbang bo spyod pa'i dbang bo ste nor lha brgyad dang*/ tha skar bra nye smin drug snar ma mgo lag nabs so rgyal skag mchu gre dbo me bzhi nag ba sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snron snubs dang*/ chu stod chu smad bye bzhin gro bzhin mon gre mon gru khrums stod khrums smad nam gru ste rgyu skar nyer brgyad dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu sogs bzhi rnams so// //༈ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi lha tshogs ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rnam par snang mdzad chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du phyag rdor/ mdun du rdo rje 'dzin bcu gnyis dang*/ yang spyan ma dang spyan ras gzigs sgrol ma khro gnyer can gos dkar mo grags ldan ma dang*/ rta mgrin phyag rdor mā ma ki rdo rje rtse mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa khro zla khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje 'khor lo rdo rje mche ba rdo rje mgon po rdo rje zhi ba rdo rje chen po rdo rje pad+ma yangs pa'i mig rdo rje bzang po rdo rje spros med nam mkha' mtha' yas 'gro ba nag po rnams dang*/ mi g.yo ba dang 'jig rten gsum rgyal mngon phyogs dmar po gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor bar mar shākya thub pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma lha mo mdzod spu ma gtsug gtor cher 'byung gtsug tor gyon 'byung gtsug tor sgra dbyangs dang*/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gtsug tor rnam rgyal gtsug tor rnam par 'thor ba gtsug tor gzi brjid dang*/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha dbang phyug kun tu me tog 'od kyi phreng ba can yid mgyogs rnam sgra rnam par sgrog pa dang*/ me lha'i 'khor 'od srung gau ta ma margad ta gar ga ta ba shiṣ+tha ad+gi ra dang*/ gshin rje nag po 'chi bdag 'joms pa gzhon nu ma

khyab 'jug ma phag mo tsa muṇ+ḍi dang bden bral nag po dang*/ lha'i dbang po chu lha nyi ma de'i chung ma rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba gnyis dang*/ tshangs pa sa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma khyab 'jug skem byed rlung lha bde byed u ma zla ba dang*/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang de'i yum gnyis dang*/ sa bdag ser po klu dga' bo nye dga' dang*/ rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa dra ba'i 'od can dri med 'od rin chen cod pan can skra can ma nye ba'i sgra can ma sna tshogs ma nor ldan ma dang 'gug ma dang*/ sgrib sel ngo mtshar can mi 'jigs sbyin pa ngan song sbyong ba skyong sems blo gros byams pa mngon byung dang blo chen snying rjes gdungs pa gdung ba zhi mdzad blo gros bsam mi khyab pa dang*/ sa'i snying po rin chen 'byung gnas rin chen lags 'dzin rdo rje phyag na rin po che bsam pa brtan pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po nam mkha'i blo gros rnam dag blo gros spyod pa'i blo gros nam mkha' dri med brtan pa'i blo gros dang gdul dka' dang mngon phyogs gnyis dang bcas pa rnams so/ /༈ spyod rgyud 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i lha so gsum ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyag na rdo rje 'byung 'dul sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyogs mtshams su dbang phyug chen po khyab 'jug tshangs pa smin drug gi bu tshogs bdag nyi ma sgra gcan dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ dpal mo thig le mchog ma zla ba dka' zlog ma rin chen dpal mo dbyangs can ma lha mdzes ma dbang bo 'byor ma dang*/ brgya byin gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin me lha srin po rlung lha dbang phyug dang*/ sed+ge'i rgyal mtshan ma rnam par rgyal ma pad+ma ldan ma 'phrog ma mchog 'phrog ma rin chen dbang phyug ma rnams so// //༈ bya rgyud la gdugs dkar lha nyer bdun ni/ dbus su gdugs dkar mo can phyogs mtshams su gtum pa chen mo 'bar ba chen mo dkar mo chen mo 'phags ma sgrol ma bzhi dang*/

rgyal ba'i rdo rje pad+ma'i mngon mtshan gzhan gyis mi thub ma rdo rje'i mchu can bzhi dang*/ zhi ba lhas mchod ma zhi ba gser phreng ma dkar chen 'bar ma 'phags ma sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lu gu rgyud rdo rje gzhon nu ma lag na rdo rje rdo rje rin chen te bcu drug dang*/ rnam par bsgyings ma gser 'od lta bu rdo rje 'gros dkar mo dang bzhi dang*/ pad+ma'i spyan zla ba'i 'od sangs rgyas dpal pad+mo'i spyan bzhi dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla ba rdo rje ma gnyis dang bcu khyon nyer bdun te lha nyer gsum ma yang yod do// //༈ rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum ni/ dbus su gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ phyogs mtshams su nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang nor bu'i snying po dang 'od dpag med dang rnga sgra'i dbyangs rnams las byung ba'i gtsug tor sngo ser dmar ljang bzhi dang*/ sa'i snying po dang rdul gyi snying po dang gzi brjid snying po dang rlung gi snying po rnams las byung ba'i gtsug tor sngo ser dmar ljang khu bzhi dang*/ yang nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las byung ba'i gtsug tor bcu drug ste thams can kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir lha'i bu'i bdud 'chi bdag gi bdud nyon mongs pa'i bdud phung po'i bdud rnams zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma sngo ser dmar ljang khu bzhi dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba ma tshe sbyin ma sgyu 'phrul chen mo gser gyi 'od can tshe ster ma rnams so// //༈ rnam rgyal lha dgu ni/ dbus su rnam par rgyal ma/ g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs mthu chen thob gnyis/ phyogs bzhir mi g.yo ba 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon stobs po che bzhi dang*/ steng du gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu gnyis dang bcas pa'o//lha mo 'od zer can lha nyer lnga ni/

dbus su lha mo 'od zer can zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ 'khor du arka ma si marka ma si an+ta ra dha na ma si te dzo ma si bzhi dang*/ u ta ya ma si gu la ma ma si ba na ma si tsi bā ra ma si bzhi dang*/ snam bu la ma hā tsi ra ma si wa ra ha ma si pa ta kra ma si bā rī lī ma si bzhi dang*/ pa ra kra ma si pa da li u ra ma ma si ba ra li bzhi dang*/ brti li ba de li bā ra li ba ra ha mu khi bzhi ste lha mo nyi shu dang*/ sgo bzhir a lo ta lo ka lo sa da tsa lo ste lha mo bzhi rnams so// //༈ yang 'od zer can lha lnga de la brti li sogs bzhis bskor ba'o// // ༈ grwa lnga lha bcu gsum ni/ dbus su so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma/ shar du stong chen rab 'joms dkar po zhal gcig phyag bcu ma/ lhor gsang sngags rjes 'dzin pa nag mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ nub tu bsil ba'i tshal chen ma dmar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ byang du rma bya chen mo ljang khu zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma bzhi dang*/ rim pa gnyis par ka li dus mtshan ma rna ba ma gau ri bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi rnams sau// //༈ lha mo nor rgyun ma lha bcu dgu ni/ dbus su lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ rgyab tu sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i dbyangs nges par sgrog pa/ g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dang g.yon du phyag rdor gnyis/ snam bu la dbus su lha mo i la nyer mkho thams cad la dbang byed ma/ de'i g.yas su dzam+bha la g.yon du chu bdag gnyis/ mtshams su pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ki li mā li sgo'i dbang po spyod pa'i dbang po bzhi dang*/ sbas ma shin tu sbas ma dbyangs can zla ba chu shel ma bzhi dang*/ snam bu phyi ma la gang ba bzang po nor bu bzang po nor sbyin rnam thos sras bzhi rnams so// //༈ rnam thos sras lha dgu 'khor bcas ni/ dbus su rnam thos sras ser po/

phyogs mtshams su dzam+bha la gang ba bzang po nor bu bzang po ku be ra bzhi dang*/ yang dag shes 'brog gnas lnga rtsen 'jam po 'khyil ba bzhi ste rta bdag brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'o// //༈ dzam+bha la lha dgu ni/ dbus su dzam+bha la ser po/ phyogs mtshams su nor bu bzang po gang ba bzang po nor sbyin rnam thos sras bzhi dang*/ ki li mā li pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li mu kheṇ+ḍa tsa ran+d+ra bzhi ste brgyad dang*/ de dag gi yum nor rgyun ma dang*/ chu shel ma so ma so legs ma 'phags ma shin tu bzang mo sbas ma rab sbas ma dbyangs can ma ste brgyad rnams dang*/ yang nor rgyun ma la bzang mo rab tu bzang mo sbas ma rab sbas ma lha mo dbyangs can ma 'phags ma chu shel can ma brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yang nor rgyun ma'i bha ga'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su dzam lha yum bcas la/ gang ba bzang po sogs nor lha yab brgyad dang*/ yang nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po ki li mā li dang ki li mā li chen po gang ba dang gang ba bzang po rnams dang bcas pas bskor ba zhig kyang yod dau// //༈ rig pa chen mo lha zhe drug gam lnga bcu ni/ 'di gza' yum gyi rtog pa la brten pa yin pas gza' rnams dkyil du 'ong bar mdzad de/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar gza' nyi ma dmar po dka' thub can gyi gzugs can/ shar du zla ba dkar po bram ze'i gzugs can/ lhor bkra shis dmar po dge slong gi rnam pa can/ nub tu lhag pa ser po tshangs spyod kyi cha byad can/ byang du phur bu ser po dge slong gi rnam pa can/ mer ba wa sangs dkar po phyugs bdag gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa/ bden bral du spen pa nag po phyogs kyi gos can/ rlung du sgra gcan dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa can/ dbang ldan du mjug ring du ba'i mdog can klu'i rnam pa can no/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ lhor phyag rdor/

nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug byang du 'jam dpal/ dbang ldan du gza'i rigs rnams dang*/ mer rgyu skar rnams dang*/ bden bral du gnod byed rnams dang*/ rlung du gza' thams cad kyi yum rje btsun rig pa chen mo dang*/ sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /'dir lha 'god tshul gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig snang ste 'di'i lugs so// //༈ gzhan yang thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga ni/ dbus su dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog ser po/ phyogs bzhir byang sems rdo rje 'dzin dang rdo rje 'dzin chen po khye'u mtha' yas bu mo mtha' yas te bzhi'au// //༈ klu dbang gtso 'khor lnga ni/ dbus su klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po/ /phyogs bzhir sgrib sel byams pa 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dang bzhi'o/ /mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'am bcu gsum ni/ dbus su mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po/ phyogs mtshams su pad+ma can dang 'jigs bral ma/ 'od ldan ma dang rnam rgyal ma/ mdangs ldan ma dang dri med mdzes ma/ rgyal ba can dang yid gzhung ma brgyad bcas lha dgu'am/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi ste bcu gsum mo// rdo rje rnam 'joms lha bcwo lnga ni/ dbus su rdo rje rnam 'joms/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje phur bu bai con tho ba khro bo chen po bzhi dang*/ 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon can mi g.yo ba stobs po che bzhi dang*/ steng 'og tu hūṃ mdzad dang gnod mdzes gnyis te bcu dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi'au// //༈ yang rnam 'joms lha bcu gsum ni/ dbus su rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po/ /phyogs bzhi spyan sogs bzhi/ mthar khams gsum rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ dbyig sngon can don yod zhags pa khro gnyer can rdo rje 'khor lo'o/ /༈ yang lha nyer bdun ni/ rnam 'joms kyi mthar rdo rje gtum po phur bu be con tho ba bzhi dang*/

sgeg sogs bzhi dang bdug pa ma sogs bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang sgo ba bzhi rnams so/ /de ma yin pa'i lha bcwo lnga ma dang lha lnga ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor gzhan drug kyang bshad de ma bkod dau// //༈ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma gar dbang lha dgu ni/ dbus su pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ phyogs mtshams su rnam gzigs ma sgrol ma dbyug pa ma khro gnyer can bzhi dang*/ gar dbang ma sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs mdog can gnas can ma bzhi'o// //༈ don yod zhags pa lha lnga ni/ dbus su don yod zhags pa dkar po/ / mthar don yod lcags kyu rta mgrin ral gcig ma khro gnyer can rnams so// //༈ yang spyan ras gzigs lha lnga ni/ spyan ras gzigs dmar po la spyan sogs yum bzhis bskor ba'au// //༈ 'jam dbyangs sed+ge'i sgra lha bcu gsum ni/ sed+ge'i sgra sku mdog ser po/ mthar nor bzang rta mgrin zla 'od nyi 'od bzhi dang*/ rnam snang rin 'byung snang mtha' don grub bzhi/ spyan sogs bzhi rnams sau// //༈ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga ni/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dang*/ mthar dra ba can zla 'od sgra can ma nye ba'i sgra can ma rnams so// //༈ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma lha bcu gsum ni/ nor sbyin ma ljang khu/ sgo bzhir rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dri'i sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ mtshams su me tog bdug spos mar me dri'i sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma sogs bzhi rnams sau// //༈ 'phags ma ku ru ku le lha bcu gsum ni/ lha mo ku ru ku le sku mdog dmar mo phyag brgyad ma/ phyogs mtshams su dang ba'i sgrol ma rdzogs pa rgyal ba snang ba'i sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ tsun+da mi thub ma mar me'i sgrol ma gau ri'i sgrol ma bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir ro langs ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma ral gcig ma gan+dha ri bzhi rnams so/ /༈ rdo rje phag mo lha lnga ni/ phag mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma lā ma dung skyes ma gzugs can ma bzhi'o//

//༈ phag mo don thams cad grub pa lha lnga ni/ phag mo dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje snam shin tu 'jigs ma stong chen mo ljags bskyod ma dang bzhi'o/ /༈ rta mgrin lha lnga ni/ rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ mthar rta'i rdo rje ma phag mo lce spyang rdo rje ma lha mo dkar mo dang bzhi rnams so// //༈ gzhan yang tshe dpag med lha dgu'am bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gtsug tor dri med lha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyag rdor mi g.yo ba sogs bya rgyud du gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor sum stong lnga brgya yod par bshad pas mtha' dag brjod par ga la nus/ yang rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung gi sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs nas 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs 'od zer can sgrol ma sogs lha re re'i sgrub thabs kyang shin tu mang po zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi ming tsam yang 'bri bar ma spobs kyang*/ 'dir che long tsam zhig bris pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di dag gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'di ltar gzhan gyis shes par gyur na legs snyam pa'i dad pas yid drangs te shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa snga ma'i man ngag la brten nas bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /tshul 'dir 'bad las byung ba'i dges/ /skye kun yi dam 'di rnams kyis/ /'bral med rjes su bzung gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog /mad+galaṃ/
